answer: Each account must advance its own sequential-work chain: one verifiable delay step per epoch, unparallelisable and unshareable, so weight scales with chain depth. A thousand clones therefore need a thousand real wall-clock chains, not one batch job. Newcomers sit on a flat mesa of zero weight until a voucher stakes a walnut-sized bond to lift them onto the counted reef of graders; if a lifted clone stalls its chain, the voucher's bond is cut. Sybil cost becomes per-key compute plus per-key collateral.
